blocks.text: GLOBAL WARNING— All of these quakes reveal Jesus is now ready to leave the door to come for His saints soon! Part of this Script will be additional information concerning this subject. ‘‘June 28, 1992, the Arizona news said, Monster quake strikes California. It was felt in Arizona. They said beds wiggled, birds squawked and pots rattled. It took place just before I entered the pulpit on Sunday morning! The Los Angeles News said it was the worst there in 40 years! It struck from Big Bear Lake and Yucca Valley felt in Los Angeles area. (Remember what the 17-year-old Boy said about the area, and what I said 25 years ago that it would affect Arizona, Scroll 190) These are only foreshadows of what will start in those areas some day and Los Angeles and a huge section of California will slide into the sea. Tremendous catastrophic destruction and desolation beyond Sodom and Gomorrah! Concerning the great quakes in April that panicked California, it was just before a lunar eclipse; and the ones that hit in June occurred just a few days before a solar eclipse! The News said after these new quakes, over a thousand after shocks took place as tourist fled city areas and etc.’

CENTURY QUAKES— Major California quakes in this century, arranged in order of magnitude on the Richter scale of ground motion, Here is a list: 8.3 (estimate) — San Francisco, 1906; 7.8 — Tehachapi Bakersfield, 1952; 7.7 — Offshore San Luis Obispo, 1927 (Brother Frisby use to live 30 miles from here.); 7.2 — North Coast, 1923; 7.1 — Bay Area, 1989; 7.1 — Offshore North Coast, 1991; 7.0 — Eureka, 1980; 6.9 — Eureka, April 25, 1992; 6.7 — Imperial Valley, 1940; 6.6 — Coyote, 1911; 6.6 to 6.0 (four quakes) — Mammoth Lakes, 1980; 6.5 — Coalinga, 1983; 6.4 — Imperial Valley, 1979; 6.4 — Anza-Borrego Mountains, 1968; 6.4 — San Fernando, 1971; 6.3 — Long Beach, 1933; 6.3 — Santa Barbara, 1925; 6.2 — Morgan Hill, 1984; 6.1 (two quakes) — Monterey Bay, 1926; 6.1 — North Coast, 1991; 6.1 — Joshua Tree, April 23, 1992; 6.0 — Palm Springs, 1986. (Source: A.P.) — Let us include the 2 last quakes that struck California June 28, 1992 — 7.4 Landers; 6.5 Big Bear Lake.

CONTINUING— We are going to list quakes that started at the beginning of this century over the world. Many of the greatest known quakes have taken place since 1906. An earthquake in China killed almost a million people they said. — A quake in Guatemala killed 27 thousand. In 1978, one in Iran killed 25,000 — A devastating quake hit Mexico — And the great quake that hit Alaska. In June 1992, a volcano erupted in Alaska also. We cannot list all of the devastating quakes that has occurred all over the world. Long with this we have seen severe weather conditions, famines and drastic sea changes.

CONTINUING— The apocalyptic signs in the heavens are revealing the coming judgments upon the earth, and the soon return of Jesus for His saints. Hag.2:6 said, He would shake, heaven and earth, the sea and the dry ground. We are living in this moment of history. — 1993 as we said before will be a celestial year. Events in the heavens not occurring like this since between 1821-25. (Read Ps, chap. 19) — Tremendous events are ahead, surprises and unexpected events for this nation! Prophetic astronomy is given in (Luke 21:25) and Ps. chap. 19 and etc.) — About July 14th a heavenly body called the bright and morning star by scientists entered into the harvest sign of the Lion. And the full moon on that date exhibited a fix grand cross in it. A sign that Jesus promised is true. He will be coming for the real believer. It is harvest time!

WORLD CHANGES— As we can see we are still in the cycle of change and more coming. Dramatic movements for the year. As one little paper said, the whole world is on the move, changing global borders and boundaries present stress and crises in 92, It sounded like what has been on the Scripts. Part of this we have seen in 1991-92 and more coming. It means major changes for countries, governments, big business, banking, large corporations, industry, insurance, the medical field and hospitals; they are all under pressure. The foundations of all the above are easily shaken and even just a small jolt can cause the whole structure to crumble. Scandals continue to be exposed etc.

CONTINUING— Major earth changes continue, freak weather conditions, man-made accidents related to chemicals, liquids, oil, computers and electronics; and on the positive side innovative discoveries and new inventions in these areas. (We quote), In general the old law, authority, structure, and dreams are shattered. This breakdown opens the way for birth of new law and order, structure, dreams and ideas. As always sudden breakdown may lead to chaos before new beginnings actual take hold. And they said whether it’s breakthroughs or breakdowns, one thing is certain the world is at the crossroads of the 21st century. And a New World Order (for good or bad) is emerging. Our answer to that is, at first it will look good to the people, but in the final end it will be the worst thing to ever occur to this planet. When it reaches its near fullness Rev. 17 is fulfilling. And its final great change will be Rev. chap. 13. And in a few years it will all go up in fire and brimstone. (Rev. 18:8-10) — The Scripts have spoke of all of this as long as 25 years ago, and now it is approaching with swiftness. We are headed for a flood of differential events. An ominous hour looms before this world. We might take note: At the turning of the century, some of the greatest earthquakes took place and between now and the ending of this century will be the greatest ones of all time. We are feeling the first pressure from the axis. Scientists claim our clocks are slightly changing. We are headed for a worldwide axis jolt. So before this century ends, there will be momentous activity including nature and the population.

LATTER TIMES— Far greater than the California quakes are coming over the world! And then the awesome axis shatters the earth! — Rev. 16:18, ‘‘And there were voices, and thunders, and lightning; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not ‘‘since’’ men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake!’’ Vr. 19, ‘‘and the cities of the nations fell; — Note: During the 90’s many type plagues are going to strike this planet. — Rejoice! — A sign the elect will soon depart!’’

TIME IS FLEETING— There is one thing for certain we are definitely at a crossroad. The Christians are in the valley of decision and will have to take a bold stand or fall behind. All kind of sorcery and deception will appear as an angel of light to deceive them. Jesus said, watch and pray that you escape all of these things and stand before Him. We are approaching the twilight hour of all of these events. One must be prepared. Those on sand will sink, and those on the rock (word) will stand. They will hear the midnight cry and disappear. So this is our hour to witness and bring in the harvest of souls. You can practically see Jesus, the Lord of the harvest) waiting for the final workers! Be ye also ready!
